verdict.rationale: Rippling's benefits docs cover enrollment administration (one-click reopen, plan comparison, dependent and coverage approval, EOI handling), and HR changes including benefits deductions flow automatically into payroll, with EOI decisions adjusting payroll deductions in bulk. However, offering health insurance plans specifically is only implied by references to 'coverage' and 'plans', and all evidence is vendor marketing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of offering and setting up health insurance plans (carriers, plan types, open enrollment setup), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the enrollment-to-payroll deduction sync.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer and administer health insurance with enrollments and deductions synced to payroll

citations.quote: HR data—like new hires, salary changes, and benefits deductions—flow directly and automatically into Payroll.
Rippling matches each decision to the right employee, updates their coverage, and adjusts payroll deductions in bulk.
Reopen an employee’s benefits enrollment in one click.
Employees can get instant answers to questions, compare plans, and submit qualifying life events with AI, on desktop and mobile.
Automatically approve dependents, update coverage, and route EOI in bulk
